title: The areas' edge color tables: res/lighting/edge_colors.json
description: The files of ARCID_AREA_EDGE_COLOR_TABLES (a/0/1/5), in order: the table that an area's edge_color_table names (res/field/areas/; AreaData_GetEdgeColorTableID, 255 for none, which turns edge marking off), which Field_LoadEdgeColorTable in fieldmap.c gives the 3D engine (G3X_SetEdgeColorTable), with edge marking on except in the zones of IsZoneEntralinkEdgeColorTable. tools/data/area_color_data.py packs them.

items.description: The colors of the outlines around the models, by the top three bits of their polygon IDs; the game replaces the last with gray (16, 16, 16)
